baseline.worktree: Clean before this pass; final changes remain local and uncommitted.

publication.verification: Remote refs queried after development; main and tag still point to the release commit.
publication.new_development: No version change, commit, tag, push or deployment in this pass.

scope.meaning: Actual settings form load/review/event-save/compiler-save/verification and navigation/unmount/Strict Mode ownership; confirmed event retention invalidates unread state.
scope.boundaries: Controlled browser responses and clock; all non-fixture network blocked. Two existing tests use a disposable local production Next server with intercepted synthetic API responses.
excluded: real deployment credentials, database, Engine, Agent, SSH/LAN and kernel mutations
metrics polling and Runner Agent administration transport

findings.observed: Failed event reads enabled saving cached/default settings.
findings.fix: Only validated server events establish readiness; locked controls and explicit reload.

findings.observed: Obsolete Strict Mode reads overwrote the current settings.
findings.fix: Abortable request generations bound to Engine/navigation/reload; late results cannot publish.

findings.observed: String ok acknowledgement advanced to compiler save.
findings.fix: Exact response types, true acknowledgement and equality with reviewed normalized values.

findings.observed: Navigation during event save allowed a late compiler POST.
findings.fix: Propagate confirmation cancellation and validate generation/scope at async handoffs; unmount invalidates publication.

findings.observed: Event success plus compiler failure showed raw error without explicit partial state and allowed save again.
findings.fix: Four-locale partial/unconfirmed notices, confirmed event state, unread invalidation and reload-before-new-save; no raw backend text.

findings.observed: Stalled initial reads had no deadline or reload action.
findings.fix: Private credentialed no-store/redirect-error requests; 10000 ms per read, 20000 ms per write including body, even for abort-ignoring transport. No automatic mutation retries.

baseline.meaning: Six observed first-failure assertions; not every later protective branch independently failed first.

harness_diagnostics.note: Default cached Playwright browser executable absent; installed Chrome used thereafter, no browser download.
Initial Response stream/React settling assertions; controlled body responses introduced.
Wait for observable dialog failure before asserting feedback.
Initial fix; malformed acknowledgement feedback assertion ran before failed-dialog render.
Expanded harness corrected to observe new read requests/readiness/dialog closure and exact Refresh metrics label; no additional runtime change needed.

request.overlap: Included again in full-gate frontend count; not additive.

production_page_subset.note: Existing tests, synthetic API; not new cases or live Engine acceptance.

final_preflight.note: After final bilingual documents and course mirrors; runtime source unchanged.

frozen_map.note: Earlier map-drift.log output is identical, but its tee pipeline lacked pipefail; final run records checker exit 1.

evidence.meaning: Selected source hashes, exact raw logs and historical byte preservation; not a clean release or an exhaustive source manifest.

limitations: Abort, timeout and response loss are unconfirmed, not rollback; admitted server work can complete after a later reload.
Settings requests are sequential, not one transaction. Reads are neither a quiescence proof nor cross-process coherence; event settings are owner-scoped and compiler mode is global.
Browser cooperative timers do not bound CPU/event-loop stalls or Engine worker lifetime.
No live browser/Engine/PostgreSQL end-to-end, explicit PostgreSQL rerun, full optional-browser suite, remote CI inspection, Rust dependency audit, deployment/LAN/kernel acceptance.
Metrics polling and Runner Agent transport remain out of scope.
next: F03 performance-metrics loading/refresh and error recovery, then the F24/F25 Runner Agent administration boundary.
